tasks.title: Channel normalization
tasks.statement: PX4 1.17. The channel is calibrated: `RCn_MIN` = **{mn}**, `RCn_TRIM` = **{tr}**, `RCn_MAX` = **{mx}** µs, `RCn_REV` = 1. The receiver outputs **{v} µs**. Find the normalized channel value (−1…+1).
tasks.answer: (v - tr)/(mx - tr) if v > tr else (v - tr)/(tr - mn)
tasks.solution: `rc_update.cpp`: a piecewise linear function through (MIN, −1), (TRIM, 0), (MAX, +1). Below TRIM: (v − TRIM)/(TRIM − MIN); above: (v − TRIM)/(MAX − TRIM). The halves of the scale are scaled separately, so with TRIM off center the same shift up and down gives different values.

tasks.title: Mode slot from a pulse
tasks.statement: PX4 1.17, `RC_MAP_FLTMODE` points at a channel calibrated `MIN` = **{mn}**, `TRIM` = 1500, `MAX` = **{mx}** µs. The channel pulse is **{v} µs**. Which slot (1…6) does the firmware select?
tasks.solution: Normalize first: v_n = (v − TRIM)/(MAX − TRIM) above the center or (v − TRIM)/(TRIM − MIN) below. Then `UpdateManualSwitches`: slot = int(((v_n + 1.05)·6 + 1/6)/2.1 + 1/6) + 1, at most 6. The slot boundaries on the normalized scale: −0.786, −0.436, −0.086, +0.264, +0.614; the channel center always gives slot 4.

tasks.title: The parameter under the knob
tasks.statement: A knob on a channel with `MIN` = 1000, `TRIM` = **{tr}**, `MAX` = 2000 µs is bound to `MC_ROLLRATE_K` with a `PARAM_MAP_RC` message: value0 = **{v0}**, scale = **{sc}**, min = **{lo}**, max = **{hi}**. The knob is at **{v} µs**. What value does the parameter get?
tasks.answer: min(hi, max(lo, v0 + sc*((v - tr)/(2000 - tr) if v > tr else (v - tr)/(tr - 1000))))
tasks.solution: `set_params_from_rc()`: param = clamp(value0 + scale·rc, min, max), where rc is the normalized knob value (its center is its `TRIM`). Normalize the pulse first, then add it to value0 and clip to min and max. The value is saved by autosave; the binding is not.

tasks.title: Acro rate with expo and superexpo
tasks.statement: `MC_ACRO_R_MAX` = **{r}** °/s, `MC_ACRO_EXPO` = **{e}**, `MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO` = **{g}**. The roll stick is deflected **{x}** of its travel. Find the angular rate setpoint, °/s.
tasks.solution: `math::superexpo`: expo(x) = (1 − e)·x + e·x³; rate = expo(x)·(1 − g)/(1 − |x|·g)·MC_ACRO_R_MAX. At full stick the multiplier is 1, so the maximum always equals `MC_ACRO_R_MAX`.
